text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Thirtieth Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate the easterly southbound curb lane on Thirtieth Street, from Elder Avenue to a point 30.5 metres north, be designated for southbound left turns only. The proposed lane designation will clearly define lane usage and mitigate any potential vehicular conflicts.

City Council on February 5, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate the easterly southbound lane on Thirtieth Street, from Elder Avenue and a point 30.5 metres north, for southbound left turns only.
